propositions: Documentation falsely claims bug tickets are exempt from the plan-review gate, but code shows bugs undergo light advisory review under the bug tier.
The bug review tier was intentionally introduced in epic 6982 to provide necessity probing and DET floor assessment for bugs while ensuring they always pass.
Two documentation locations need correction: docs/plan-review-gate.md and the review_plan docstring in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py.
Only session_log, code_review, and identity types are truly gate-exempt with runner=exempt; bugs are reviewed but never blocked.
The CLI-side claim-time bug exemption (rebar._commands.gates) must be distinguished from gate-review exemption to prevent conflation of two separate exemption axes.
